source_statement: For every finite real Chain n l r with arbitrary natural bonds, including empty/zero/deficient cases, the specified deterministic tail-first thin-LQ recursion returns actual residual R and right-canonical chain D with unchanged terminal dimension r, exact backward cap s_n=d_n and s_i=min(d_i,2*s_(i+1)), full matrix action contract C x=R*contract D x for every word, and maxBond D<=maxBond C. For every real initial row v, boundary vR preserves all word/terminal amplitudes and chainMass C v=mass(vR). Normalization follows only given input chainMass one; the scalar Chain n 1 1 specialization recovers every scalar amplitude and has normalized boundary only under its stated squared-sum-one premise. No numerical-rank minimality, arithmetic cost, finite-bit stability, or physical circuit/root theorem is included.
